answer: Proposal: admit only keys bearing a manufacturer-signed enclave quote, one identity per attested instance, and pay R per epoch only for continuous heartbeats signed inside the enclave; one rented slot sustains a single stream, so no spare slot can mirror a twin. Cap R below the slot rental rate c: N clones then cost N·c, earn N·R over the same horizon — a canyon of pure loss, floored in basalt. Assumes honest chip manufacturers; cloud rental sets c, and R must track it.
